projects.name: AI Native Lexicon
projects.description: A shared vocabulary for building AI systems. Structured concepts, design primitives, and a navigable skill map.
projects.zh: 为 AI 系统设计建立可探索的术语、设计原语和 Skill Map。

projects.name: NovaCreo
projects.description: A deterministic CAD command core with validation gates and replayable execution. The live Creo modeling adapter is not yet implemented.
projects.zh: 具备预检查和可回放执行的确定性 CAD 命令内核。真实 Creo 建模适配层尚未实现。

projects.name: AI-MLS
projects.description: A whitelist-only learning pilot: image capture, manual correction, spaced review and feedback. Student-account integration remains pending.
projects.zh: 面向白名单的小范围学习试点：拍照、人工校对、间隔复习与反馈。正式学生账户集成尚待完成。

projects.name: Effects Lab
projects.description: A browser graphics lab with seeded parameters, shareable experiments and tested mathematical motion loops.
projects.zh: 浏览器图形实验室：固定种子参数、可分享实验配置，以及经过测试的数学运动循环。
